answer.explanation: Wallet is low (<30% of initial), so conserve by contributing ~30% of wallet (~0.51). It's a broadcast round, so send norm message. Insufficient funds to punish.

message.reasoning: We need decide action for round 16. Wallet 1.71, below 30% of 100 (30). So conserve: contribute 30% of wallet = 0.513. Round 16 not broadcast? Broadcast every 5 rounds starting round1: rounds 1,6,11,16... Yes 16 is broadcast round. So must broadcast norm message. Also can punish if any free rider two rounds under 10%? Look at history: Resident2 contributions: round14 0.63, round15 0.43, both >10%? 10% of endowment =10 units, these are way less, but threshold is 10 units not percent. Two consecutive rounds below 10 => punish. Must have severity 10 cost 3. Cost = severity * punishment_cost? Actually cost to sender = configured punishment_cost per unit, so 10*0.3 =3. We have wallet 1.71, cannot afford 3, so cannot punish. So actions: contribute 0.51 (rounded maybe 0.51) and broadcast message. Provide JSON.
